import json,subprocess
def run(raw):
    p=subprocess.run(['python3','-I','-B','project/solver.py'],input=raw,capture_output=True)
    return p.returncode,p.stdout.decode().strip(),p.stderr.decode()[:200]
base={"cases":[{"primitive":"allreduce","mode":2,"root":0,"segments":1,"words":1,"capacity":1,"start":0,"events":[]}]}
def C(**kw):
    d=dict(base['cases'][0]); d.update(kw); return {"cases":[d]}
def E(events,**kw): return C(events=events,**kw)
tests={
 'valid':json.dumps(base),
 'empty cases':json.dumps({"cases":[]}),
 'not json':b'{',
 'trailing value':json.dumps(base)+b' {}',
 'duplicate key':b'{"cases":[],"cases":[]}',
 'bad utf8':b'{"cases":[{"primitive":"\xff"}]}',
 'missing key':json.dumps({"cases":[{k:v for k,v in base['cases'][0].items() if k!='start'}]}),
 'extra key':json.dumps(C(extra=1)),
 'bad primitive':json.dumps(C(primitive='nope')),
 'mode 1':json.dumps(C(mode=1)),
 'mode 4':json.dumps(C(mode=4)),
 'root 4':json.dumps(C(root=4)),
 'float mode':json.dumps(C(mode=2.0)),
 'bool mode':json.dumps(C(mode=True)),
 'segments 0':json.dumps(C(segments=0)),
 'segments big':json.dumps(C(segments=2**20+1)),
 'words 0':json.dumps(C(words=0)),
 'capacity 0':json.dumps(C(capacity=0)),
 'capacity big':json.dumps(C(capacity=4097)),
 'start big':json.dumps(C(start=2**24)),
 'barrier words':json.dumps(C(primitive='barrier')),
 'barrier ok':json.dumps(C(primitive='barrier',words=0,segments=1)),

 'scatter ok':json.dumps(C(primitive='reducescatter',segments=4)),
 'trace big':json.dumps(C(trace=33)),
 'unknown op':json.dumps(E([{'op':'nope'}])),
 'data p out':json.dumps(E([{'op':'data','rank':0,'p':1}])),
 'data count 0':json.dumps(E([{'op':'data','rank':0,'p':0,'count':0}])),
 'data bad xor':json.dumps(E([{'op':'data','rank':0,'p':0,'xor':[[58,1]]}])),

 'snap tag long':json.dumps(E([{'op':'snap','tag':'x'*65}])),

 'reverse not bool':json.dumps(E([{'op':'train','p':0,'count':1,'width':1,'ranks':[0,1,2,3],'reverse':'x'}])),
 'cases not list':json.dumps({"cases":{}}),
 'cases 9':json.dumps({"cases":[base['cases'][0]]*9}),
 'top extra':json.dumps({"cases":[],"x":1}),
 'whitespace ok':b'  \n\t'+json.dumps(base).encode()+b'  \n',

}
expect_ok={'valid','empty cases','whitespace ok','barrier ok','scatter ok','snap tag ok'}
for name,raw in tests.items():
    rc,out,err=run(raw if isinstance(raw,bytes) else raw.encode())
    if name in expect_ok:
        ok = rc==0 and out.startswith('{"cases"')
    else:
        ok = rc==0 and out=='{"error":"invalid"}'
    print('%-22s rc=%d %-46s %s'%(name,rc,out[:46],'ok' if ok else '<<< UNEXPECTED'))
